trainer/30010.htm.text: Master Auron: Welcome, young traveler. This is the Warrior Guild of Gludin Village, and I am Master Auron. How may I serve you today?

trainer/30010-noteach.htm.text: Master Auron: As you can see, I am the Master of the fighters guild, and therefore I cannot teach you. Seek another Master, one that is right for you.

Q00401_PathOfTheWarrior/30010-01.htm.text: Master Auron: Now I'm a master who teaches young Fighters, but I was once a soldier for the Warrior League , walking the borderline between of life and death on the battlefield. To be accepted into the Warrior League, there's no need for a noble birth or the lord's Recommendation. We accept any Fig…

links.text: Say you want to become a Warrior

Q00401_PathOfTheWarrior/30010-07.html.text: Master Auron: You haven't met Simplon yet? He works at a weapons shop in the town of Gludio . If you show him my letter, he will tell you everything you need to know about the sword of trial .

Q00401_PathOfTheWarrior/30010-08.html.text: Master Auron: I see you met Simplon. It gather that he asked you to do something difficult, because he certainly doesn't give the Sword of Trial to just anyone. But don't be too upset. Though he seems tempermental on the outside, he's really a warm person once you get to know him.

Q00401_PathOfTheWarrior/30010-02.htm.text: Master Auron: You are still too inexperienced. The damage to your armor and the callus on your palm show me that plainly. Come back after you are more seasoned. At that time, I will be willing to test you to determine if you are indeed qualified to be a true Warrior. (Only characters level 18 and a…

Q00401_PathOfTheWarrior/30010-02a.htm.text: Master Auron: Why has one who has already attained the title of Warrior come to seek me? Is not your place on the battlefield? Leave at once! May the goddess of victory smile down on you!

Q00401_PathOfTheWarrior/30010-03.htm.text: Master Auron: You seem to have already decided on the path you will take. So why have you come to me?

Q00401_PathOfTheWarrior/30010-04.htm.text: Master Auron: You already have the medallion of the Warrior. Then you already have the qualifications to enter the warriors guild. Take the medallion and go to Grand Master Ramos of our guild, and he will change your profession to a Warrior. He's the one standing right over there.

Q00401_PathOfTheWarrior/30010-05.htm.text: Master Auron: Good! Then I will test you to see if you have the talents to become a true Warrior. It is a very simple test -- any Fighter with courage and spirit can pass it.

Q00401_PathOfTheWarrior/30010-06.htm.text: Master Auron: To take this test, you must first find the weapon that the Warriors call the sword of trial . Simplon of the town of Gludio knows all about the sword. These days, he works at a weapons and armor shop, but in the past he was a famous soldier, so treat him with respect. If you show him …

Q00401_PathOfTheWarrior/30010-10.html.text: Master Auron: How do you hunt a poison spider with a rusty sword? Look here, fellow, do you know what the creed of our warriors guild is? It's stay alive even in the worst conditions . There is no law that says you will always be at an advantage in a fight against your opponent. However, in any sit…

Q00401_PathOfTheWarrior/30010-11.html.text: Master Auron: Good! Once you've passed through the southern gate of the village, to the left you'll see the windmills of Windmill Hill. common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
